replace: same( await at( mid ), rest ) ? hi = mid : lo = mid;
why: the search for the distance runs the wrong way
the distance is the first scrolled one, not the last that still reads as rest
a page that cannot scroll is read as a header that does not change
the scrolled read is taken without scrolling
a distance is searched for even when the scroll changes nothing
transitions run during the reads, so a frame between two states is read
